Before you submit

Driver terms & conditions

1. Bookings only through Rydanu. If a traveler found you via Rydanu, the tour must be booked and paid through Rydanu. Arranging payment privately to bypass the platform is not allowed and can lead to account suspension.

2. Fees. A small platform fee applies to every booking you accept, based on the tour price, and is charged to your balance immediately when you accept — see "Fees & billing" in your dashboard.

3. Cancellations. If a guest doesn't show up, the platform fee already charged for that booking is not refunded. If you cancel a confirmed tour yourself, a fixed cancellation fee of IDR 30,000 applies.

4. Keep your profile accurate. Vehicle, documents, service regions and prices must reflect reality. Update your listing whenever your vehicle or availability changes.

5. Conduct. Be respectful, punctual and safe. Repeated cancellations, poor reviews or safety issues can lead to suspension or removal from Rydanu.

6. Payments. Rydanu never handles tour payments — guests pay you directly, in cash or via the payment details you provide (QRIS / payment link). Rydanu is not liable for errors in the details you submit.
